n- [Fetch a readiness run's full report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/fetch-a-readiness-runs-full-rep
ort.md): Every finding, with its class, provenance, publisher-documentation citation and remediation. AI-derived findings carry `p

formance-runs/start-a-persisted-conformance-run.md): Grades the saved server against the protocol, apps, and tasks suites and retu
rns `202` with a run id. The target comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL. OAuth is not startable
here. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Status, outcome, and score are three different an…\n- [List persisted conformance runs
](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/conformance-runs/list-persisted-conformance-runs.md): Newest first. Optionally narrow to o
ne saved server. `pending` counts checks the run's profile reported but did not score.\n- [Get a persisted conformance run](https:

stored. `launcher` is the label the launching client declared in `x-mcpjam-launcher`; `attribution` is how the platform record…\n-

ases` is the failing population `truncated` is computed from. `pending` on a check means this profile reported it but did not scor
e it. `404` when the run has no stored report.\n- [Read one check of a conformance run in full](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/conformance-runs/read-one-check-of-a-conformance-run-in-full.md): One check from the run's stored suite reports, with its stat
us, error and evidence. `details` and `output` are cut at 16 KiB each, and `truncated` says which were. `pending` means this profi

nt you hit it. THE TEXT IS SENT TO THE MCPJAM TEAM, outside your organization, and kept for 180 days. It is stored in MCPJam's own
